why_this_works: The long marinade allows acidic lemon juice to tenderize the chicken thighs while the warm spice blend creates complex layers of flavor that bloom during high-heat roasting. Sheet pan cooking at 425°F mimics the concentrated heat and slight char of traditional rotisserie shawarma, while the onions caramelize and add sweetness to balance the bold spices.
notes: Marinate chicken for at least 30 minutes or up to 24 hours for best flavor. Can substitute chicken thighs for breasts.

ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into strips
Tahini sauce or garlic sauce for serving
Cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion for serving
steps: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, paprika, coriander, turmeric, cinnamon, cayenne, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken strips to marinade and toss to coat. Marinate for at least 30 minutes or up to 24 hours.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper.
Spread marinated chicken and sliced onions on the prepared sheet pan.
Roast for 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through and slightly charred on edges.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then slice or chop into smaller pieces.
Serve in pita bread with tahini sauce, cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion.
recipe.serving: Serve in warm pita bread with tahini or garlic sauce, diced cucumber, tomatoes, and thinly sliced red onion
recipe.storage: Store cooked chicken in refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in oven or skillet before serving.
